title: Automatic periodic check leaves uncommitted changes in main checkout
body:
What happened: An automatic periodic check (seen with docs-links) writes its result into the committed .warden/checks/<name>.md file. After every session start, the main checkout has uncommitted changes.

What I expected: Running a periodic check should not dirty the main checkout. Results should go to an ignored/untracked location, or not into a committed file.

Steps to repeat:
1. Have a committed .warden/checks/docs-links.md in a clean checkout.
2. Start a session so the automatic periodic check runs.
3. Run git status in the main checkout.

Evidence: git status shows .warden/checks/docs-links.md as modified after the check runs; it was clean before the session started.
note: Fixed. Check results now live in warden state, not in the check file.
